REPEATABILITY FINDING (2026-08-14, added post-REFUTE-pass): 3 independent frozen replays of this exact deal, identical inputs, identical doctrine, produced Combined 32.0 / 27.5 / 28.5 -- a 4.5-point range, exceeding the harness's original 3.0-pt tolerance on its own. Tolerance widened to 5.0 pts harness-wide as a result (see diff_policy and SKILL.md). This deal is the noisier of the two HIGH-confidence rows -- Liberty Office Park's 3-run range was only 1.0 pt.

SKILL.md-CITATION LEAKAGE (identified via the repeatability check): this exact address is named in SKILL.md's own text as the worked validation example for the price-watch re-engage trigger ('Validation: 2196 Port Sheldon'). The first replay (Combined 32.0) awarded 5 Seller & Motivation points, apparently drawing on that citation's owner-user-vacating characterization -- a fact NOT present in this file's frozen `inputs`. Two independent re-replays (Combined 27.5, 28.5) explicitly declined to award those points, one of them explicitly noting the citation was inadmissible since it wasn't in the frozen fact set. This is a narrow but real leakage risk specific to golden deals SKILL.md happens to cite by name -- a frozen-replay subagent reading the full skill file sees its own answer key for that one input. Not fixable without either stripping the citation from SKILL.md (out of scope -- read-only) or excluding self-citing deals from the golden set; documented instead as a standing caveat.
The 2026-08-14 baseline replays are otherwise the cleanest of the six -- all 7 scorecard categories resolved (zero nulls) across all 3 runs.
Building SF has a minor OM-vs-assessor variance (19,777 OM vs 19,471 assessor, ~1.6%) -- below the skill's 2% no-flag threshold, normal noise, not a data-quality issue.
NOI is pro-forma/modeled ($137,027 at $7.50/SF NNN, property 100% vacant) -- expected and consistent with the Lease-Up Assumption Block, not an archive gap.
